subject: [hw] DONE V30: string/format/heap shims
body:
DONE V30.

Test command (from the work tree root):
  bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v30/run_tests.sh
Last line:
  N2TEST V30 PASS 277617/277617
All four builds report the same count: ASan+UBSan -O1 277617/277617, plain -O2 277617/277617, TSan -O1 277617/277617, -O2 -DV30_NO_VFS (weak-hook default) 277617/277617. ~15 s total, builds only under /tmp/n2hw-v30.

Implemented in my owned files only:
  shim/n2fmt.h            n2fmt(), n2fmt_args_regs/va, n2fmt_arg32/64/double, n2fmt_vscan(), struct n2fmt_input, weak n2vfs_mmap/n2vfs_errno_location prototypes
  shim/n2shim_string.c    all 27 D01 string imports (mem*/str*/atoi/atoll/qsort, __aeabi_*, __memcpy_chk/__strlen_chk/__strncpy_chk2) + snprintf/sprintf/vsnprintf/vsprintf/sscanf/__*_chk, plus extra strtol family/strchr/strcpy etc.
  shim/n2shim_format.c    exact printf (d i u o x X c s p n %%, all flags/width/precision/*/hh h l ll z j t, f F e E g G with big-integer round-half-even, no host printf) and scanf (%d %i %u %o %x %s %c %p %n, widths, suppression, literals), shared with V33 fscanf
  shim/n2shim_heap.c      malloc/calloc/realloc/free/memalign/posix_memalign, getpagesize, anonymous mmap/mmap64/munmap, one host mutex, 27 size classes, 16-byte alignment, magic-checked headers, double-free detection, diagnostics
  shim/test_v30/**        the tests and run_tests.sh

Tested: 300 generated format/arg cases x 4 AAPCS layouts (regs slot 0/2/3 + va_list) x 5 capacities against the host snprintf; format corners (ties, inf/nan, subnormals, DBL_MAX, #/0/+/space, NULL %s/%p, huge width/precision); the snprintf family shims; scanf cases; string/memory/NULL/AEABI/fortify; 100000 random heap operations with per-block patterns, a free-list walk every 500 ops, ASan+UBSan, plus 4 threads x 20000 ops under TSan; qsort with a guest comparator (host hook through n2a32_call until V02 exists); anonymous/MAP_FIXED/mmap64/munmap and both weak-hook paths.

Not done (also in dsh-state/workers/V30/STATUS.md):
  - qsort comparator assembled with llvm-mc and run through V02 (needs V02; the shim already calls n2a32_call)
  - real-guest end-to-end run (real ARM varargs code through V02/V03)
  - arm64 iOS compile check
  - %lc/%ls wide-character conversion, positional %1$d, %a/%A, scanf scansets (documented; none used by the vendor code as far as the census shows)
  - munmap does not release guest pages (no unmap in n2a32.h)

Known deliberate difference: NULL %s follows bionic ("(null)" precision-truncated), not glibc; NULL %p follows glibc "(nil)". Documented in STATUS.md.

Integration notes posted earlier: n2shim_string[] already owns snprintf/sprintf/vsnprintf/vsprintf/sscanf and __*_chk, so n2shim_stdio[] must not repeat them; fscanf forwards to n2fmt_vscan(); V33 should define n2vfs_mmap (and optionally n2vfs_errno_location) strongly. I am staying available for review findings.
